title: AI Change Management and Team Integration

questions.question: Why can a technically successful AI pilot still fail to become a team workflow?
options: Roles, handoffs, review duties, governance routines, and the desired behavior change were never made explicit
The model needs a larger context window before people can adopt it
Every pilot requires a new reporting structure before anyone can use the tool
A launch email is sufficient once the interface is available to the team
questions.explanation: Change work is workflow redesign. The plan names who is affected, who reviews outputs, how exceptions move, and which adoption metric shows that behavior changed.

questions.question: The rollout to service team fixture has three matched signals, impact=4, and uncertainty=4. What result does score_scenario and priority_for produce?
options: 14 and guided pilot
18 and launch gate required
20 and team practice
16 and awareness only
questions.explanation: The score is 4*2 + 4 + 3*2 = 18. The priority is launch gate required, not guided pilot, because the threshold is 16.

questions.question: Which category does choose_category select for the rollout to service team fixture?
options: roles
adoption
handoff
governance
questions.explanation: Three matches plus impact 4 and uncertainty 4 gives index 11 modulo 4, or 3. CATEGORIES[3] is handoff.

questions.question: Which controls are selected for a change scenario with three matched signals?
options: role map and stakeholder plan only
adoption metric alone, because it proves whether rollout worked
A launch email and a vendor support contract
role map, stakeholder plan, training path, and adoption metric
questions.explanation: recommend selects the first four controls when three signals match: role map, stakeholder plan, training path, and adoption metric.

questions.question: What happens to the brown bag fixture with no matched signals, impact=2, and uncertainty=2?
options: It is awareness only with score 6
It is a launch gate because an empty signal list is unsafe
It is team practice with score 8
It is a guided pilot because the team is already interested
questions.explanation: No signals contribute no bonus, so the score is 2*2 + 2 = 6. The common priority bands put that result in awareness only.

questions.question: What is the purpose of plan-ai-change-integration.md during rollout?
options: To replace managers by assigning every team decision automatically
To connect role impact, owners, training, review points, handoffs, and an adoption metric
To keep governance language separate from the daily workflow
To declare the pilot complete as soon as users attend the launch session
questions.explanation: The plan translates change into operating routines. It gives the team a way to discuss responsibilities and measure whether the intended behavior actually appears.
